test_title: PYST 11: SSC CHSL 2024 - General Knowledge (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a situation wherein A (female) and B (male) are working in same office, same designation, same nature of work but unequal payment, which of the following Articles of the Constitution will be applicable?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 39(d)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 39(d)** of the Constitution of India mandates that the state shall, in particular, direct its policy towards securing that there is equal pay for equal work for both men and women.
 
• This article falls under the Directive Principles of State Policy (DPSP), which are guidelines for the framing of laws by the government.
 
• The DPSPs are non-justiciable, meaning they are not enforceable by any court, but they are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
 
• Article 39(d) aims to eliminate gender discrimination in terms of wage disparity and ensure economic justice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 21** of the Constitution of India guarantees the protection of life and personal liberty.
 
• **Article 48A** deals with the protection and improvement of the environment and safeguarding of forests and wildlife.
 
• **Article 18** abolishes titles except for military and academic distinctions.
 
• The Directive Principles of State Policy are enshrined in Part IV of the Indian Constitution, and they aim to create social and economic conditions under which citizens can lead a good life.
 
• Although not enforceable by courts, these principles are crucial for governance and are considered fundamental in the governance of the country.
